extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps of each function constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
extra.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of each function on the left and right lamp per the applicable device regulation; pass if both lamps of the pair meet the same prescribed colour (red for rear position, stop and retro-reflector; white for reversing).

extra.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the installation requirements of the preceding paragraphs for the pair of rear combination lamps (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation review: if the vehicle's external shape is asymmetrical, check the positions and orientations of the left and right lamps against the preceding installation requirements (e.g. paired-lamp symmetry about the median longitudinal plane, equal height). Pass if every deviation is documented and justified solely by the vehicle's asymmetrical shape.

extra.text: The photometric requirements of each lamp function of the rear combination lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
extra.test_case: Photometric measurement of each function separately, with all other functions of the lamp switched OFF. Pass if the intensities meet the applicable photometric requirements.

extra.text: If a lamp function of the rear combination lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), it shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
extra.test_case: Apply the paragraph 5.7.2.1 projection check (≥ 60 % area or ≤ 75 mm gap) to the interdependent lamp system. Pass if either criterion is met.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
extra.test_case: Switch the rear position lamp ON at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over time (photometer/colorimeter, visual check); pass if no intentional variation occurs while switched ON other than permitted under 5.9.2.

extra.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
extra.test_case: Observer moves within Zone 1 of Annex 4 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

extra.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp, except while the front and rear position lamps are switched ON as parking lamps, daytime running lamps are switched ON, or the front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
extra.test_case: Vehicle-level functional check of the lighting switch: operate the position lamp switch ON and OFF and verify that the rear position lamps (left and right) switch ON and OFF together with the front position lamps, the end-outline and side-marker lamps (if fitted) and the rear registration plate lamp. Verify that the exemptions in 5.11.1 (parking lamp mode, DRL ON, 5.12.1 substitution) are the only cases of non-simultaneous operation. Pass: no switching state in which the rear position lamps can be ON or OFF independently outside those exemptions.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the rear position lamp function with the lamp energised as installed; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the red chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the stop lamp function with the lamp energised; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the red chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the reversing lamp function with the lamp energised; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the white chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

extra.text: The colour of the light reflected by the non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall be red.
extra.test_case: Illuminate the retro-reflector with a standard illuminant and measure the chromaticity of the reflected light; pass if the coordinates (x,y) lie within the red chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

extra.text: The number of lamps (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the vehicle installation: count the installed rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors and compare with the numbers given in the individual specifications of UN R48 (paragraph 6). Pass if the count for each function equals the prescribed number.

extra.text: If the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp or rear retro-reflector) is installed on movable components of the vehicle (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. shall be fulfilled.
extra.test_case: Review the vehicle installation drawings to determine whether any lamp function or the retro-reflector is mounted on a movable component. If so, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. by inspection and photometric/geometric checks in the relevant positions of the movable component. Pass if every condition of 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. is met; not applicable if the lamp is mounted only on fixed body parts.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), the rear position lamp shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component.
extra.test_case: Installation check on the vehicle with the movable component in each fixed position (closed and each fixed open position): verify mounting position, geometric visibility angles, colour and photometric values per R48 rear position lamp provisions; pass if all are met in every fixed position.

extra.text: If the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the rear retro-reflector shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear retro-reflectors at all fixed positions of the movable component.
extra.test_case: Installation check on the vehicle with the movable component in each fixed position: verify position, geometric visibility, colour and photometric (CIL) requirements for rear retro-reflectors; pass if all are met in every fixed position.

extra.text: Where additional lamps for the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
extra.test_case: With movable component in each fixed open position, verify additional lamps are switched ON and meet position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements of the lamps on the movable component; pass if all met.

extra.text: If the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and retro-reflector) is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), then when that component is in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on it shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: place the movable component (e.g. tailgate open) in each position other than the normal position of use with the lamp functions activated. Check light directions and visibility from relevant road-user positions. Pass if no glare or misleading or disturbing signal causes undue discomfort to road users.

extra.text: When the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector) is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid) and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
extra.test_case: If any part of the lamp is mounted on a movable body component: operate the movable component repeatedly (e.g. open/close 10 times) and return it to the normal position of use. After each cycle, verify the lamp position and orientation relative to the vehicle against the manufacturer-specified installation position (height, width, angles of geometric visibility per R48 paragraph 6). Pass if the lamp returns each time to the specified position and all installation requirements remain met.

extra.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position other than the normal position of use, locked or unlocked. Measure the projected apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of its reference axis. Pass if no more than 50 % of it is hidden.

extra.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position other than the normal position of use. Measure the apparent surface of the retro-reflector in the direction of its reference axis. Pass if no more than 50 % of it is hidden.

extra.text: If the 50 per cent limit of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable for the rear position lamp, additional lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component. These additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps.
extra.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: move the component to each position that hides more than 50 % of the rear position lamp's apparent surface. Pass if the additional lamps switch ON automatically. Verify that the additional lamps meet the R48 position and geometric visibility requirements and the colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps.

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
extra.test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp LEDs; measure colour of the replacement function and compare with the rear position lamp (red) colour coordinates; pass if similar/within red colour limits.

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in main intensity to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
extra.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure; photometric measurement of the replacement function at main test points (H-V); pass if intensity is similar to that of the original rear position lamp.

extra.text: If a device is used as temporary fail-safe replacement for the rear position lamp, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
extra.test_case: With rear position lamp failure simulated and replacement active, activate the original function of the replacement device (e.g. stop signal); pass if it still operates and meets its photometric requirements.

extra.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
extra.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure on vehicle; pass if dashboard tell-tale activates for the duration of the replacement.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, their luminous intensities, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
extra.test_case: Photometric measurement of the R2 and S2 functions at several intensity control steps under each triggering condition; pass if both functions change simultaneously, in the same direction and in a similar proportion.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained in the entire intensity range and throughout variation transitions.
extra.test_case: Continuous photometric recording of both functions during intensity transitions across the full control range; pass if the stop/position lamp intensity ratio prescribed by the pertinent UN Regulation is maintained at all times.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
extra.test_case: Time-resolved photometric recording and visual observation during intensity transitions; pass if intensity changes progressively without visible steps or abrupt jumps.

extra.text: When the electrical system of the M1 vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the vehicle category as specified by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions), where according to its type approval documentation it has been tested with a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant device or function as approved. Per paragraph 5.27.3, this does not apply if the lamp includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light sources approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: Vehicle-level demonstration to the Technical Service. Run the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage operating condition and measure the voltage at the lamp connector terminals for each function. Pass if the measured voltage is at or below the voltage stated in the lamp's type approval documentation. Not applicable if a 5.27.3 exemption applies.

extra.text: In all electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1, when the vehicle electrical system is in a representative constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent in 6 Volt-Systems. This does not apply where a paragraph 5.27.3 exemption applies.
extra.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage of each function with the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage condition. Pass if the voltage is ≤ 6.75 V × 1.03 (6.95 V).

extra.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
extra.test_case: Photometric measurement of each partially hidden function with the vehicle masking reproduced, either on the vehicle or with a masking fixture. Pass if all prescribed photometric values for device approval are met by the unhidden part across the required field.

extra.text: The LED modules of the rear combination lamp do not need to be replaceable, provided this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval; otherwise the LED modules shall be replaceable.
extra.test_case: Document review and inspection: check the component type approval communication sheet. If it states the LED module is non-replaceable, the design passes. If it does not, verify on the sample that the LED module can be removed and replaced.

extra.text: When installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp function of the rear combination lamp shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation (UN Regulation No. 148), as specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48.
extra.test_case: Documentary check: verify a valid UN R148 type approval and approval marking for the rear position lamp function on the installed lamp; pass if present and matching the installed device.

extra.text: When installed on the vehicle, the integrated rear retro-reflector shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation (UN Regulation No. 150), as specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48.
extra.test_case: Documentary check: verify a valid UN R150 type approval and approval marking for the rear retro-reflector on the installed device; pass if present and matching the installed device.

extra.text: If the rear combination lamp (light-signalling lamp) incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
extra.test_case: Design review for presence of a manufacturer logo; if present, verify the UN R148 type approval covers the lamp including the logo; pass if approval documentation and marking include the logo variant.

extra.text: A reversing lamp shall be present on the motor vehicle (mandatory on motor vehicles).
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that at least one reversing lamp is fitted. Pass if a reversing lamp is present.

extra.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device is optional.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count reversing lamp devices. Pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
extra.test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground with vehicle in reference condition on horizontal ground. Pass if lowest edge ≥ 250 mm and highest edge ≤ 1,200 mm.

extra.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angle α, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. on installed lamp: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface from 15° up to 5° down. Pass if visibility achieved over the full range.

extra.text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. on each installed lamp: verify visibility from 45° outboard to 30° inboard. Pass if visibility achieved over the full range for each lamp.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection/measurement of reference axis: verify reversing lamp reference axis points rearwards. Pass if oriented rearwards.

extra.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation; otherwise a tell-tale is optional.
extra.test_case: Check UN R23/R148 approval for failure tell-tale requirement; if required, simulate LED failure and verify tell-tale activation. Pass if tell-tale indicates failure where required.

extra.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be installed (mandatory on all categories of vehicles, including M1).
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are present on the M1 vehicle; pass if fitted.

extra.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count the S1/S2 stop lamps fitted at the rear; pass if exactly two (one in each left/right rear combination lamp).

extra.text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of each S1 or S2 category stop lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface (in the reference axis direction) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, left and right; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

extra.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if so.

extra.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface 15° upward and 15° downward (or 5° downward if mounted below 750 mm per 5.8.1); pass if visible throughout the required field.

extra.text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the reference axis of the stop lamp points rearward parallel to the vehicle longitudinal axis; pass if oriented towards the rear.

extra.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamps shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
extra.test_case: Check the component regulation (UN R7/R148) requirements for the approved LED stop lamp; if failure tell-tale required, simulate LED failure and verify the tell-tale activates; pass if it does (or if not required).

extra.text: Rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 shall be mandatory on the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted; pass if present.

extra.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
extra.test_case: Check the vehicle has exactly two rear position lamps and that each bears a valid approval mark to UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later); pass if both conditions are met.

extra.text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if so.

extra.text: For M1 vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards (inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane where mounted below 750 mm) and a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal (downward angle may be reduced to 5° where mounted below 750 mm).
extra.test_case: If the alternative is chosen, confirm rear side-marker lamp fitted and verify visibility over 45° out/45° in and ±15° vertical (with reductions per mounting height); pass if visible throughout.

extra.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Verify the lamp reference axis points rearwards when installed; pass if so.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be present on the motor vehicle (mandatory on motor vehicles).
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are fitted on the M1 vehicle. Pass if present.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
extra.test_case: Document and marking check: verify the retro-reflector approval mark and certificate show Class IA or IB to UN R3 02 series or later, or UN R150 00 series or later. Pass if a valid approval is present.

extra.text: Any additional retro-reflecting devices and materials, including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4., shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: if additional retro-reflecting devices or materials are fitted, assess their effect on the mandatory lamps. Pass if the effectiveness of the mandatory devices is not impaired.

extra.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
extra.test_case: Vehicle measurement per paragraph 5.8.1 with the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground: measure the lowest edge of the illuminating surface. Pass if ≥ 250 mm.

extra.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
extra.test_case: Vehicle measurement per paragraph 5.8.1: measure the highest edge of the illuminating surface. Pass if ≤ 900 mm, or ≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with the rear lamps (applies to this rear combination lamp), or ≤ 1,500 mm where the bodywork shape prevents compliance.

extra.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle. Pass if it is located at the rear.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above the horizontal.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify an unobstructed view at 10° upward. Pass if visible.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that the reference axis of the retro-reflector faces rearwards. Pass if oriented rearwards.

extra.text: The angles of geometric visibility of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the rear retro-reflector shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation, and the values measured shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: Measure angles of geometric visibility per paragraph 2.10.7.; pass if each function meets its individual specified angles, with a tolerance of ±3º on the angle limits.

extra.text: The visibility of red light from the rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector towards the front of the vehicle shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10. that red light is not directly visible towards the front within the prescribed zone; pass if paragraph 5.10. is fulfilled.

extra.text: The visibility of white light towards the rear of the vehicle shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10. that no white light other than that permitted (e.g. reversing lamp) is visible towards the rear; pass if paragraph 5.10. is fulfilled.

extra.text: When verifying that no red light from the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, red retro-reflector) is visible to the front of the vehicle (see paragraph 5.10.4.), zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
extra.test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground. Observe the lamp from the front within zone 1, between heights of 1 m and 2.2 m above ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp is directly visible to an observer within this zone.

extra.text: When verifying that no red light from the rear combination lamp is visible to the front of the vehicle, zone 1 shall be bounded in width by a vertical plane forming to the front an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane and passing through the point of contact of the vertical plane parallel to the median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
extra.test_case: Geometric check on the vehicle. Construct the 15° outward forward plane through the foremost point of contact of the overall-width plane. Observe from all positions in zone 1 between 1 m and 2.2 m above ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp is directly visible.
